name: A Warp button left on the bar is saved as Warpdagger (#5469)
contract: Casting Warpdagger 500287 runs StartTravel (AscensionRunemasterTravel.cpp:119, called from spell_ascension_runemaster_travel::SummonDagger), which learns Warp 500587 as a temporary spell (learnSpell(child, true), line 142) and replaces Warpdagger with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 143) while the dagger is out. Echo Rune 500270 -> Echo Return 500272 shares the same lines. A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before the dagger could be thrown again, so a saved Warp button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding Warp must be saved as Warpdagger, and a button holding Warpdagger itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: The thrown dagger replaces Warpdagger with Warp
The Warp button is saved as Warpdagger
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
